content: पातालम् [पतत्यस्मिन्नधर्मेण पत्-आलञ्; <ab>cf.</ab> <ls>Uṇ. 1. 114</ls>] .²1 The last of the seven regions or worlds under the earth said to be peopled by Nāgas; the seven regions are:-- अतल, वितल, सुतल, रसातल, तलातल, महातल and पाताल. .²2 The lower regions or world in general; मा मेति व्याहरत्येव तस्मिन् पातालमभ्यगात् <ls>R. 15. 84</ls>, <ls n="R.">1. 80</ls>; पातालान्न विमोचितो बत बली नीतो न मृत्युः क्षयम् <ls>Subhāṣ.</ls> .²3 An excavation, a hole. .²4 Submarine fire. .²5 (In <ab>astrol.</ab>) The fourth house or sign from that in which the sun is present. .{@-लः@} .²1 A kind of instrument for distillation or the calcination and sublimation of metals. .²2 <ab>N.</ab> of Jupiterʼs year (of 361 days).
